item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today. With the trough of low pressure weakening gradually, it will be brighter and hot over the coastal areas in the middle and latter parts of this week. Another trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China over the weekend.

Date/Month: 06/05 (Tuesday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. More showers and a few thunderstorms in the morning.
Temp range: 25 - 30 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
